answer: Gate paid work behind a delayed-release reputation bond. When a newcomer applies for its first paid job, it must stake 220 POA locked for 60 days, and its first ten payouts are released only after a random spot-check of the work. If a spot-check catches copied output or a shared payout route, the whole stake is burned and the identity is barred for a year. A farm of one hundred fakes must therefore risk 22,000 POA before earning anything, while a copper-mine auditor, a ledge-safety inspector, or a horizon-charting cartographer builds standing one verified job at a time.
